welcome: Welcome! Set the game's folder and a test copy in Settings to use every tool.
area.buildings.intro: The exports, deployments and their undo, as forms. The generator itself is on the Buildings screen.
area.textures.intro: Tileable textures, AI repaint, a unit's UV atlas and its repaint by body part, LoRA datasets and training.
area.survey.intro: Measure the art of the game and of the mod, and look inside its files. Reports of a mod name its files: keep them private.
area.art.intro: Flags, icons, rings, health bars, and fixes for models and animations.
area.dev.intro: Tools for working on this program itself: sweeps, galleries, sheets, swatches, zips.
b.intro: Pick a preset, change what you like, and watch it change. Exports need Blender.
b.random.help: Random options of the current style
b.random.none: This style has no random options yet.
b.full.help: Paint the texture at its own size (up to 1024 px here) once a change settles; off: a quick 256 px preview
b.texsize: Shown at {n} px. The export paints it at the size chosen in the form.
b.p90: Buildings of class {cls} in the game: 90 % have under {p90} triangles, the largest {max}.
b.budget.help: Against what the game's own buildings of this size use
b.over: Over the budget. The owner cares about optimisation: is the extra cost worth it?
b.noblender: Exports need Blender: install Blender 4.2 or newer, or set its path in Settings.
b.export.files.help: The model as GLB, FBX and OBJ with its texture, a .blend and three renders
b.load.bad: Those options could not be read:
b.deploy.nocopy: Set a test copy of the game in Settings to deploy into it.
b.deploy.confirm: Deploy the last game export into {copy}? Backups are kept and Undo restores the copy.
b.undo.confirm: Take every deployed building out of {copy} and restore its files?
outputs.more: {n} files in all: Show in folder for the rest.
jobs.intro: Every task started in this session, with its log.
tool.trial.help: The trial shows what would change. Apply runs it for real, once a trial with the same values has passed.
tool.apply.confirm: Apply the changes the trial showed?
settings.intro: Where things are. Nothing here leaves this computer.
settings.engines.help: Blender is needed for the game export, the GLB/FBX/OBJ export and renders; ComfyUI for the AI tasks; the Granny bridge for compressed game models.
eng.python.detail: built in: previews, sheets, every tool without Blender
eng.bpy: the bpy module of this Python
set.game.help: The game's installation. The studio only reads it, never writes into it.
set.mod.help: The mod's own folder, to survey its art.
set.test_copy.help: A copy of the game to deploy into and test. A Steam folder is refused.
set.work.help: Where the studio writes what it makes, unless a task says otherwise.
set.cache.help: Caches of game files (uncompressed models), outside the game and outside this program.
set.blender.help: blender.exe. Empty: the newest installed Blender is found by itself.
set.granny.help: The external .exe that reads compressed models through the game's granny2.dll. Not shipped with the studio.
set.comfy_url.help: The address of ComfyUI, for the AI tasks.
set.comfy_dir.help: The ComfyUI folder (ComfyUI_windows_portable), to train LoRAs.
i.title: Look inside a game file
i.intro: A texture (.ddt), a model (.gr2), a compiled XML (.xmb) or an archive (.bar): read only, nothing is written.
i.binary: A binary file of {n} bytes: its first bytes.
i.more: The first 500 shown: filter to find the others.
i.texture.none: Its texture is not beside it: shown in clay.
b.ai.help: Repaints the texture region by region with the local ComfyUI, keeping its layout (about a minute)
